name: interactive-docs
description: Interactive, self-contained HTML docs for any project: infrastructure topology, AI/LLM workflow diagrams and an evidence-backed user guide, exportable to PDF and Word.

interface.shortDescription: Infra, AI-workflow and user-guide docs for any project
interface.longDescription: Reads your codebase and builds up to three single-file, offline, theme-aware HTML docs: a clickable deployment/infrastructure doc with a seeding runbook, an AI workflows doc with a mermaid diagram of every model call, and an interactive user guide backed by real screenshots or transcripts. All export to PDF and Word.
defaultPrompt: Build an interactive architecture doc for this repo
Diagram every AI/LLM call in this project
Make an interactive user guide for this app
